title: Senior React Native Engineer, Consumer Alliance

From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

The alliance is responsible for cross-cutting initiatives that maximize business value through modernized payment processing, dynamic customer activations and reactivations, and organic growth channels like SEO. • Deep understanding of integrating frontend and backend services seamlessly

title: Senior Developer & Technical Project Manager

○ APIs and integrations
○ GitHub workflows
○ Deployment platforms (Vercel preferred)

Hardware Engineering is a diverse, innovative, and collaborative group of electrical, mechanical, reliability, software and vehicle engineers. You will:

You have:

• Proven ability to create and negotiate targets and requirements with OEMs and partner companies/suppliers

• Ability to work in an ambiguous world and find a path forward to resolve seemingly conflicting requirements

 

We prefer:

• Min Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Masters is preferred

• Experience in the future mobility sector, e.g. outside of the traditional OEM/personal car ownership model

• Experience at more than one OEM, to give a broader perspective of Product Development methodologies

• Experience in occupant package and vehicle layout specific to electric vehicles

• An interest in the Autonomous Vehicle sector and how it is shaping future mobility

 

Travel requirements  

• Global travel required for on-site OEM engagements (10%)

• Occasional travel to other Waymo locations, suppliers, and service providers on an as-needed basis (10%)

We’re looking for a sharp, driven, problem-solving Senior Software Engineer (Ruby on Rails) to join our Platform engineering team.
As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform Team , you’ll work alongside other engineers, designers, and product managers to tackle everything from huge company initiatives to modest but important bug fixes. While your primary focus will be backend development, we value engineers who are T-shaped, bringing deep expertise in one area while being comfortable contributing in others. Whether that means diving into frontend code, supporting mobile efforts, or lending an extra set of eyes in discovery, you’ll collaborate with your teammates to move work forward.
Most importantly, you’ll actively contribute to the evolution of the culture and processes of a growing engineering team , especially our backend engineering discipline. title: Director of AML & Virtual Asset Compliance
description:
About the Company
Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem. Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.
 
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced compliance and financial crime leader to help shape and expand our work across anti money laundering, virtual asset compliance, and blockchain risk management. This role is designed for someone who understands compliance from both sides of the market: traditional financial institutions and virtual asset service providers. You should be comfortable operating at the intersection of regulation, financial crime prevention, blockchain analytics, and commercial strategy. You will serve as a senior subject matter expert on AML and virtual asset compliance, helping the company strengthen its compliance capabilities, advise financial institutions and VASPs, and engage credibly with regulators, law enforcement agencies, clients, and industry partners.
 
About You
You are a practical and commercially minded compliance leader with deep experience in AML, financial crime, and virtual assets. You have worked within, or closely alongside, both traditional financial institutions and VASPs, and understand the differences between conventional transaction monitoring and the risks presented by blockchain based financial activity. You are equally comfortable reviewing a complex financial crime case, designing an AML framework, advising senior leadership, speaking with a regulator, and explaining blockchain risk to a bank, exchange, or government stakeholder. You do not approach compliance as a purely administrative function. You understand how strong compliance programs, credible risk controls, and effective blockchain analytics can support responsible business growth.

The expected annual base salary range for this position in the United States is $150,000 to $220,000. Compensation for candidates outside the United States will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

People Operations is the operational engine of the People function at Cint .
Our mission is to build a scalable, intelligent and employee-centric operating model that enables the business to grow without increasing complexity. We achieve this by combining exceptional operational excellence with technology, automation and AI.
The way companies operate is changing rapidly. AI is transforming how work gets done, employees expect consumer-grade experiences, and global businesses need operations that scale without adding complexity. Most People Operations functions are still built for yesterday's world. We intend to build one for tomorrow.
This role will lead that transformation.
You will work closely with People Technology, Employee Relations, People Partners, Talent Teams, Total Rewards, Payroll, IT and Legal. title: Bilingual Medical Assistant - Front & Back Office
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Bilingual Medical Assistant to join our remote team. This is a dual front and back office role requiring strong clinical knowledge, excellent communication skills, and the ability to provide outstanding patient support in a virtual environment.
The ideal candidate is fluent in English and Spanish , has hands-on experience with athenahealth (athenaOne) EMR , and has experience working in an orthopedic or U.S.-based clinical setting . The ability to independently manage a high volume of patient interactions while maintaining accuracy, professionalism, and HIPAA compliance is essential.
athenahealth (athenaOne) experience and English/Spanish bilingual fluency are non-negotiable requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Front Office:

• Answer and manage high-volume inbound patient calls in both English and Spanish.

• Schedule, confirm, and reschedule patient appointments using athenahealth.

• Verify insurance eligibility and collect patient demographics and intake information.

• Route calls appropriately to clinical staff, providers, and departments.

• Communicate appointment preparation instructions, office procedures, and practice policies to patients.

• Provide timely and professional follow-up with patients as needed.

Back Office & Clinical Support

• Triage patient calls and respond to medical questions within the Medical Assistant scope of practice and under provider supervision.

• Process and submit prescription refill requests through athenahealth on behalf of providers.

• Coordinate outgoing referral calls to specialists and ancillary facilities.

• Follow up with patients regarding lab results, imaging, and care plan instructions as directed by the provider.

• Return patient calls and address medical questions within scope.

• Document all patient interactions, call notes, and clinical communications accurately in athenahealth.

• Send and respond to patient messages through the athenahealth patient portal.

• Assist providers with prior authorization requests and referral coordination.

• Ensure all clinical documentation is complete, accurate, and HIPAA compliant.

Requirements

• Hands-on experience with athenahealth (athenaOne) EMR - REQUIRED, no exceptions.

• Fluent English and Spanish - REQUIRED.

• Minimum 2 years of Medical Assistant experience in a U.S.-based clinical setting.

• Orthopedic experience strongly preferred.

• Front and back office experience strongly preferred.

• Certified Medical Assistant ( CMA or RMA ) preferred, but not required with sufficient relevant experience.

• Strong knowledge of medical terminology, prescription workflows, referrals, and patient communication.

• Ability to accurately respond to clinical questions within the Medical Assistant scope of practice.

• Excellent phone etiquette and patient service skills.

• Strong multitasking, organization, and time-management abilities.

• Self-motivated and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.

• Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in an orthopedic, specialty, or multi-specialty medical practice.

• Familiarity with prior authorization processes and insurance verification.

• Experience using the athenahealth patient portal and messaging features.

• Knowledge of HIPAA requirements and telehealth/remote-work compliance standards.

• Experience handling a high volume of inbound and outbound patient calls.

Benefits
Please note that this is a full-time contractor position (40 hours per week) with a negotiable pay rate depending on skillset and experience. The schedule is Monday through Friday, from 9 AM to 5 PM CST.

title: Floating Medical Office Customer Service (LATAM only)
description:
This is a remote position.

Only LATAM-based candidates (bilingual in Spanish and English)
​ The Floating Medical Office Customer Service position provides temporary administrative coverage to different medical practices when staffing gaps occur due to vacations, sick leave, resignations, increased workload, or other unexpected absences. Unlike an assistant dedicated to a single client, the floating assistant must be able to quickly adapt to different providers, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols while maintaining service quality and minimizing disruption to the client. The position follows a rapid deployment model, meaning the floating assistant is not permanently assigned to a fixed group of clients. Instead, onboarding is provided when coverage is required for a specific medical practice.
Responsibilities Responsibilities will depend on the workflows and operational requirements of each assigned medical practice and may include:

• Following appointment scheduling rules and provider preferences.

• Supporting insurance workflows.

• Assisting with referral processes.

• Supporting prior authorization procedures.

• Following patient communication protocols and telephone scripts.

• Following established escalation procedures.

• Maintaining internal documentation standards.

• Navigating Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.

• Reviewing and following client-specific documentation and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).

• Following daily operational processes and checklists.

• Adapting to different medical practices, workflows, software systems, and operational protocols.

Requirements

• Must have your own device and headset

• High-speed internet connection of at least 100 MB.

• Previous experience working with U.S.-based medical offices and knowledge of HIPAA regulations.

• Ability to quickly adapt to different medical practices, providers, workflows, and operational protocols.

• Ability to continuously learn and transition between different client environments.

• Ability to learn and navigate different Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems and software platforms.

• Ability to understand and follow practice-specific scheduling rules, insurance workflows, referral processes, prior authorization procedures, and patient communication protocols.

• Ability to follow telephone scripts, escalation procedures, and internal documentation standards.

• Ability to review and follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operational guides, and daily checklists.

• Ability to work effectively following an accelerated onboarding process for each new assignment.

• Previous experience with medical offices is preferred.

Systems Medical practices may use different software platforms, including:

• Athenahealth

• eClinicalWorks

• Nextech

• HealthArc

• EMA

• Other proprietary systems

The position requires the ability to understand not only the software used by each practice, but also the operational processes and procedures established by that particular medical office.
Assignment and Onboarding Model When coverage is required:

• A client reports an upcoming absence or unexpected staffing need.

• A floating assistant is assigned.

• The assistant receives an accelerated onboarding.

• The assistant reviews the client's documentation.

• The assistant begins providing temporary coverage until the assigned employee returns.

Because medical offices may operate differently, each assignment may require adaptation to new workflows, provider preferences, software systems, and operational procedures. Comprehensive client documentation, structured onboarding, and ongoing support during the initial stages of each assignment are key components of the floating coverage model.

About the Role
A well-funded seed-stage AI infrastructure startup is looking for experienced Design Systems specialists to help build the data layer that teaches AI models what great design looks like. You'll work on production-grade design systems used to evaluate and train AI design tools - building them, implementing them in code, and assessing how well AI systems ingest and reproduce them.
This is a contract, fully remote role with async flexibility and quick turnarounds. You can join on one of three tracks:

• Design Track: Build complete design systems in Figma - tokens (color, type, spacing, radius), component libraries with variants and states, and golden screens composed exclusively from library components.

• Product Design Track: Envision product designs from scratch using and implementing existing design systems, maintaining strict adherence throughout.

• Prompt AI models to generate and refine design work from a brief across multiple conversation turns

• Evolve the underlying design system: refine color ramps, type scales, spacing and radius tokens, and component treatments

• Evaluate AI outputs on design-system coherence, visual quality, and fit to the brief - flagging where adherence breaks down

• Compare outputs, select the stronger one, and write clear rationale and reproduction prompts grounded in expert judgement

• Vote and rank preferences to help train models on what a cohesive, high-quality design system looks like

• 3+ years of professional experience building and owning token-based design systems (color ramps, type scales, spacing and radius tokens, components with variants and states)

• Experience with React or Figma variables for design system implementation

• Sharp eye for adherence - you notice when a corner radius, casing rule, or spacing value drifts from spec

• Ability to write structured, specific creative direction grounded in design-systems principles

You will ensure strong alignment, coordination, and predictable outcomes across multiple teams while driving both successful delivery and continuous improvement in how work flows through the system.
As an RTE for Workplace Solutions, you will lead mission-critical programs that span five or more teams and multiple business and technology partners. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Буде плюсом:

- Досвід роботи із Tableau

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. - Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше.

- Турбота про щоденний комфорт. Сніданки, обіди, доступ до спортивних тренувань в Києві або часткова компенсація занять у Варшаві, медичне страхування, оплачувані відрядження, якщо специфіка ролі передбачає такі поїздки, корпоративні знижки від партнерів.

Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві.

Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!

title: Accounting Manager, GL& Close
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

We're hiring an Accounting Manager, GL & Close to run the more complex parts of our monthly close and to push large sections of it forward as Deepgram scales through its first external audit and toward public markets. You'll report directly to the Chief Accounting Officer on a small, deliberately lean finance team, and transition to the Senior Director, Accounting once that role is filled - which means unusual proximity to the top of the function from day one, and a manager above you who has taken a company through this exact arc before.

Your manager owns the close. You own the parts of it that carry the most judgment, and you move the rest of it along without waiting to be asked. Practically, that means you'll prepare in the areas where the answer depends on a call rather than a formula, and review in the areas where the process is established - with the line between the two moving as the team grows and as the business gets more complicated.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the workpapers, not just over them. If you're looking for a seat where you assign schedules and approve them, this isn't it. If you want to own the technically hardest work in the close while developing the people who own the rest, it is.

It's also a build, not a maintain. The close you inherit is a startup close. The close you leave behind has to survive an external audit, an ERP migration off Xero, and SOX - and it has to run on a team that stays small, which means it runs on AI. We're not looking for someone who closes faster with AI on the side. We're looking for someone who rebuilds the work around it.

About the role
We are building a new interactive entertainment project for families (parents + children) - with YouTube as the main platform and content home.
Short-form content (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) will serve as the acquisition engine: hooks, teasers, cliffhangers, and emotional moments designed to drive viewers to the main YouTube episodes.
You will own the creative direction for both long-form and short-form - ensuring every piece of content works together as a system, not separately.
Before we invest in full production, we will first test concepts using short-form content to measure audience demand, engagement, and intent to watch longer episodes.

• Ensure concepts resonate with parents culturally and emotionally, with a focus on the TR market

What you have done before (real experience we need)

• You have concepted and led production of long-form YouTube content (8-20+ min) - episodic, story-driven, with clear hooks and payoff.

• You understand YouTube organic metrics (CTR, retention, AVD) and short-form metrics (completion rate, shares, comments) - and how they relate.

• You have worked on projects with participatory or community elements (even simple ones like comments shaping next steps).

Key responsibilities

• YouTube first: Everything starts with the long-form episode. Short-form serves it, not the other way around.

• Test fast: Use short-form to validate concepts before building full episodes.

• Own the creative vision from title/thumbnail to final frame of each episode.

• Collaborate with production teams but stay responsible for viral instincts and audience psychology.

• Analyze performance across both formats and iterate quickly.

Requirements
Must-have qualifications

• Portfolio with long-form YouTube content you concepted (show retention, CTR, or growth if possible).

• Proven ability to drive traffic from short-form to long-form (examples required).

• Deep understanding of TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts as acquisition tools, not standalone entertainment.

• Obsessed with hooks, pacing, cliffhangers, and payoff.

• Strong interest in parenting, family dynamics, or human stories involving children

Requirements:

• Experience leading video projects from concept to final delivery.

title: Chief Sales Officer
description:
A high-ticket B2C business is hiring a Chief Sales Officer to take full ownership of its sales organisation and scale it well beyond where it sits today.
The business turns over the equivalent of around R16 million a month across roughly 160 front-end sales. The sales function works. It is not where it needs to be, and that is the job.
You will report directly to the CEO. The Sales Team Lead, who is also the strongest closer in the business, reports to you and stays in his seat on his existing structure. Closers and setters sit beneath him. The structure is CEO, then you, then the Sales Team Lead, then the closers and setters.
This is not a role for someone stepping up into the biggest job of their career. The business wants someone who has already run a larger and more sophisticated sales organisation than this one, and who can bring that experience, those systems and that thinking in with them.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Overall sales strategy and the performance of the whole sales organisation.
Managing, mentoring and developing the Sales Team Lead.
Close rates, sales volume and revenue.
KPI analysis, and finding the constraints holding performance back.
Forecasting and performance reporting to the CEO.
Sales process, scripts, objection handling and methodology.
The call review, coaching and training systems.
Diagnosing individual weakness across closers and setters, and fixing it.
Standards, accountability and energy across the sales floor.
Future recruitment and capacity planning.
The management structure and systems needed to scale significantly.
Working directly with the CEO on sales strategy and growth.
The question you will answer continuously: what is stopping this business performing at the next level, and what has to change to get it there?
Requirements
WHAT YOU MUST HAVE
10 years plus in sales, with significant time at senior leadership level. Ideally you have held the title of Chief Sales Officer, VP of Sales, Sales Director or a very senior Head of Sales.
You have managed Sales Managers or Team Leads, not only individual salespeople. This is the deal breaker. Managing closers directly is not the same job and will not be enough here.
You have run a sales organisation materially larger than this one. Be ready to state the revenue you carried, the headcount and the structure.
Specific, evidenced performance improvements you personally drove. A number, an intervention, a before and an after.
You have built the systems, not just used them. Call review, coaching cadence, scripts, objection handling, forecasting, KPI reporting. Designed by you, not inherited.
Fully remote-ready. Fibre, backup power, a working camera and a quiet space, and you can hold UK working hours permanently.
NICE TO HAVE
High-ticket B2C experience, particularly coaching, education, consulting or something comparable.
Experience taking a team through a step change in volume, not steady-state management.
Previous experience working remotely into a UK business.
THE PACKAGE
R60,000 to R65,000 per month basic, plus a performance commission on every front-end sale above the current baseline of 160 per month. As a guide, at 200 sales a month the commission is around R9,400 a month. At 250 it is around R21,000. At 300 it is around R33,000. On that basis, realistic earnings at 250 sales a month are roughly R83,000 per month. The baseline is reviewed periodically as the business grows.
Full-time and permanent. Fully remote from anywhere in South Africa, on UK working hours.
HOW TO APPLY
In your application, answer these directly: the largest sales organisation you have managed, in revenue and in headcount; how many Sales Managers or Team Leads reported to you and for how long; and one performance improvement you personally drove, with the number before and the number after. Applications that do not answer all three will not get past the first read.

Oklo is seeking an Environmental Specialist to support environmental compliance, field oversight, permitting coordination, procedure development, and environmental stewardship activities associated with nuclear and industrial development projects in southeastern Idaho.

This role will work closely with construction, operations, licensing, engineering, and regulatory teams to ensure environmental compliance across active project sites and related field activities. The position requires field presence and direct interaction with contractors, regulators, and internal stakeholders.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, field-oriented, technically capable, and comfortable operating in dynamic construction and industrial environments with high standards for safety and documentation. Additionally, the candidate must be a strong technical writing capable of producing technical procedures for supporting meeting Oklo’s environmental stewardship and compliance requirements.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Manage regular meetings with partners such as Batelle Energy Alliance (BEA) and the Department of Energy Idaho (DOE-ID)

• Work with Oklo subject matter experts to track documentation related to environmental authorizations, approvals, and permits for projects in Southeast Idaho

• Conduct environmental field inspections and compliance assessments at active project and construction sites

• Interpret environmental requirements and support implementation of environmental compliance programs, permits, and site environmental procedures

• Monitor internal Oklo teams and contractor compliance with environmental requirements and best management practices (BMPs)

• Assist with stormwater, erosion and sediment control, dust control, spill prevention, and waste management oversight

• Coordinate environmental monitoring activities including water, air, soil, and waste tracking as needed

• Support preparation and maintenance of environmental reports, inspection logs, permit documentation, and corrective actions

• Identify environmental compliance issues and implement corrective actions.

• Assist with spill response activities, investigations, and follow-up actions

• Interface with federal, state, and local regulatory agencies when required

• Coordinate with engineering, construction, procurement, subcontracts, operations, and other teams to ensure environmental requirements are incorporated into project planning and execution

• Track and communicate environmental compliance risks and emerging issues

• Support environmental audits, readiness reviews, and corrective action programs

• Help maintain environmental documentation systems and records

• Participate in field walkdowns, project meetings, and environmental planning discussions

• Travel periodically to project and operational locations within Idaho and surrounding regions as needed

• Familiarity with State of Idaho, Bonneville County, Bingham County and City of Idaho Falls environmental regulations

• Promote environmental awareness and continuous improvement initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Biology, Ecology, or a related technical discipline

• 3+ years of experience supporting environmental compliance, construction environmental oversight, industrial operations, or related field activities

• Familiarity with environmental regulations and permitting requirements including:

• Clean Water Act

• Stormwater permitting

• Spill prevention and response

• Hazardous waste management

• Air quality and environmental compliance programs

• Experience performing environmental inspections and documenting findings

• Strong technical writing and reporting skills

• Ability to work safely in active industrial and construction environments

We're looking for a Finance Systems Lead to own and evolve the systems that support Baseten's finance operations, including ERP, planning tools, and the broader finance and adjacent systems stack, spanning HRIS/payroll, CPQ, and commissions, as we implement, integrate, and automate across them.

As Baseten scales, so does the number of systems finance depends on and touches, from the ERP to planning to compensation and quote to cash tooling. This role exists to bring a dedicated owner to that stack, someone who can lead implementations (partnering with contractors or vendor CSMs for hands-on technical configuration where needed), keep systems integrated and clean as we grow, and find automation opportunities that save the team time.

This is a highly cross-functional role. You will partner with Accounting, FP&A, People, Sales and Revenue Operations, Legal, and IT to understand how each team uses its systems, and design integrations and workflows that serve the business without creating more manual work.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Core Finance Systems

- Own finance systems strategy, configuration, and roadmap, partnering with contractors or vendor CSMs on hands-on technical configuration as needed

- Lead the implementation and ongoing administration of our finance systems and tools

- Own finance system integrations end to end, ensuring clean data flow between ERP, planning, billing, and other systems, partnering with contractors or vendor CSMs on hands-on technical configuration as needed

Cross-Functional Systems

- Partner with People on HRIS and payroll systems, ensuring accurate data flow between HRIS, payroll, and ERP

- Partner with Sales and Revenue Operations on CPQ and commission systems, ensuring pricing, quoting, and commission calculations tie cleanly back to billing and revenue recognition

- Serve as a systems thought partner across finance-adjacent tools, even in areas where another team owns day to day administration

Automation and Process Improvement

- Identify and build automation across manual finance workflows, from data reconciliation to reporting, partnering with the Data Analytics team where relevant

- Evaluate new tools and system enhancements as the company scales, and build the business case for investment

- Document system architecture and workflows so institutional knowledge does not live in one person's head

Governance and Controls

- Manage system access, permissions, and controls in partnership with Accounting and IT

- Support audit requests related to systems and automated controls

REQUIREMENTS

- 7+ years of experience in finance systems, business systems, or related systems administration role

- Experience implementing or administering a financial planning tool

- Experience integrating systems across finance and adjacent functions, such as HRIS/payroll or CPQ/commissions

- Strong technical aptitude, with the ability to build automation and workflows and to direct contractors or vendor CSMs on hands-on configuration work

- Strong cross-functional partnership skills, able to work with Accounting, FP&A, People, Sales and Revenue Operations, and Legal to design systems and workflows that serve each team's needs

- Comfortable operating as a systems generalist across a broad stack, not a single-tool specialist

- Based in San Francisco or New York, with the ability to work in-person

title: Mission Success Manager, Federal
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon’s federal market team seeks a customer-obsessed Mission Success Manager who consistently overdelivers. Our federal public safety customers operate in high-stakes environments with challenging missions, and they need a trusted partner who can turn complex problems into meaningful outcomes.

As a Mission Success Manager, you will be that partner. You will own a portfolio of Axon’s most important federal customers, develop a deep understanding of each customer’s mission, and take accountability for their success. You will bring together the best of Axon to solve hard problems, ensure our technology delivers real operational value, and build partnerships that make Axon indispensable to the missions you support.

 

What You’ll Do

Location: Boston, NYC or Washington DC Area preferred
Reports to: Director, Customer Solutions
Direct Reports: 0
Travel expectation is 50%

•
You own mission success. You are accountable for your customers’ success with Axon-from delivering their programs effectively to driving adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement. You connect what Axon delivers to the outcomes your customers need to achieve.

•
You are the customer’s trusted partner. Build strong relationships with stakeholders from day-to-day operators to senior executives. Earn their trust by being responsive, candid, and reliable, and become the person they turn to when they have a challenge, an idea, or need help navigating Axon.

•
You make complex programs run effectively. Manage scope, schedule, cost, dependencies, and risk across your portfolio. Bring clarity to ambiguity, proactively remove obstacles, and ensure commitments turn into outcomes.

•
You orchestrate Axon around the customer. Work across Sales, Deployment, Technical Support, Product, Engineering, and other teams to deliver what the customer needs. You know who to engage, when to engage them, and how to drive alignment across organizational boundaries.

•
The misses keep you up at night. Anticipate problems before they become escalations and take ownership when things go wrong. Identify recurring pain points and emerging customer needs, drive them toward resolution, and ensure lessons learned turn into action.

•
You know how your decisions impact the business. Understand how decisions around product scope, services, costing, scheduling, and contract structure affect both customer outcomes and company performance. Identify opportunities where Axon can solve additional customer needs and partner with Sales to grow and scale the relationship.

•
You have a low ego, high impact attitude. You set a high bar for yourself, bring recommendations instead of just problems, and do whatever is needed to drive the right outcome. You are excited by being an individual contributor because it gives you the opportunity to solve hard problems and make a measurable impact.

What You Bring

•
5+ years supporting complex federal customers or programs - Experience in federal program management, customer success, professional services, consulting, or a similar customer-facing role is strongly preferred.

•
Deep customer and mission orientation - You seek to understand what the customer is trying to accomplish, why it matters, and what success looks like.

•
Strong program management skills - You can manage complex scope, schedules, dependencies, risks, stakeholders, and commitments across multiple workstreams.

title: Technical Support Engineer I
description:

About the Role:

TrueML Products is seeking a Platform Enablement Engineer I to join the Platform Enablement Team (PET) and help support the operational health of our platform. In this role, you will investigate technical issues, troubleshoot platform and workflow failures, support internal stakeholders, and partner with Engineering when deeper technical expertise is required.

This role is designed for an engineer who is building their technical troubleshooting skills and learning to independently navigate increasingly complex platform issues. You will work with experienced team members while developing proficiency in areas such as log analysis, API troubleshooting, database investigation, and application behavior. Success in this role requires curiosity, strong communication, attention to detail, and a willingness to continuously develop your technical capabilities.

Work-Life Benefits

• Unlimited PTO

• Medical benefit contributions in congruence with local laws and type of employment agreement

What You'll Do - Technical Investigations & Troubleshooting

• Investigate platform, workflow, and client-reported technical issues.

• Develop familiarity with AWS services used by the platform and use AWS tooling and resources as part of technical investigations and troubleshooting.

• Use logs, monitoring tools, and available system data to identify potential causes of failures.

• Perform API troubleshooting using tools such as Postman.

• Validate JSON payloads and use browser developer tools to investigate client-side behavior.

• Perform basic SQL queries to validate data and support investigations.

• Reproduce issues and document findings before escalating to Engineering.

• Learn to navigate application code and system architecture to better understand platform behavior.

What You'll Do - Ticket Ownership & Operational Support

• Provide timely updates so stakeholders understand the status of their requests.

• Support Jira triage and other operational responsibilities of the Platform Enablement Team.

• Follow established escalation, handoff, and documentation processes.

What You'll Do - Partnership & Collaboration

• Collaborate with other Platform Enablement engineers when troubleshooting complex issues.

• Prepare clear, actionable escalations when Engineering assistance is required.

• Provide Engineering with relevant logs, reproduction steps, investigation results, and business context.

• Remain engaged with escalated issues and help drive them toward resolution.

• Develop an understanding of platform architecture, services, and dependencies.

• Participate actively in team troubleshooting sessions, stand-ups, and technical discussions.

• Share useful findings and troubleshooting techniques with teammates.

• Contribute to internal documentation and troubleshooting guides.

title: Practice Manager – Paediatric Hearing & Allied Health
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Our client is an Australian paediatric hearing services business that assesses children's hearing across clinic, school and home-visit settings, and delivers a growing program of hearing screenings in schools across NSW (expanding to 30-40 schools next year). Billing is mostly through Medicare and private patients, with a small but growing number of NDIS-funded families. The business is led by its Practice Owner, who this role reports to directly, supported by a small team of audiologists and casual screeners.

ABOUT THE ROLE

• A full-time Practice Manager role - in Australian healthcare, this sits above a medical receptionist, owning the administrative and operational back end of the clinic (patient and referral administration, reporting, scheduling and compliance) rather than front-desk reception duties.

• The role is split across two core areas: day-to-day patient and referral administration in the practice's patient management system, and end-to-end coordination of the school hearing screening program - from first enquiry through to the results summary sent back to each school.

• This role is trusted with genuinely confidential information - referrals, clinical reports, Medicare and patient details, and student data - so accuracy and discretion matter on every task, not just the obvious ones.

• This role is not asked to just follow instructions - it's expected to review its own work, ask questions, and genuinely learn a process once rather than needing it re-taught.

• Day to day, this role works independently across several systems (a patient/practice management system, Excel, Outlook, Canva, SharePoint) and will regularly hit things that don't quite fit the standard process - a missing referral, a doctor not yet in the system, a parent's booking details not matching their child's. The right person investigates and resolves what they can before escalating, rather than deferring every question upward.

• There's a lighter, ongoing layer of practice support on top of this - scheduling and rostering audiologists and casual screeners, social media content, SOP updates and compliance record-keeping - that adds variety without taking priority over the patient and school-screening workload.

PRIMARY PURPOSE

To independently and accurately manage patient and referral administration, and to coordinate the school hearing screening program end to end - on schedule, with genuine attention to detail and confidentiality - while escalating only genuine exceptions rather than routine questions.

title: AI Resilience Partner
description:
EQL Tech is partnered with Convergent Research in the search for an outstanding AI Resilience Partner. Convergent Research is a nonprofit science studio best known for pioneering the Focused Research Organization (FRO): purpose-built, mission-driven orgs designed to solve technological bottlenecks, unlock whole new fields, and lead to scaled revolutions. We’ve proven our model works by building over 14 high-impact scientific organizations spanning AI (here), biotech, mathematics, climate science, and more.
AI capability is compounding faster than the world's ability to absorb it. Other technologies got decades to sort out their safety codes, their testing regimes, and the institutions that enforce them. We don't have decades. The defenses have to be built while the technology is still moving, and there's no budget line anywhere that says build the defenses now.
That's the gap this role exists to close. Not "how do we build another AI company" - plenty of people are doing that. This role is about building the missing institutions and technical infrastructure that make the world resilient to advanced AI: the defensive capabilities that won't be built by a startup, won't fit inside an academic lab, and are too important to leave to chance.
What you’ll do
Partners at Convergent are like senior partners at a venture incubator. You'll create and fully own a growing portfolio of FROs and other scientific projects that advance AI resilience - society's capacity to capture AI's benefits while withstanding its risks.
The portfolio is yours to define, but the surface area is much bigger than model safety alone. It spans defensive biosecurity (pathogen-agnostic detection, next-generation PPE, rapid countermeasures), provably secure cyber-physical systems and formal verification, epistemic infrastructure for a world flooded with AI-generated content, independent evaluation and monitoring capacity, compute governance, economic modeling of the transition - and areas nobody has named yet. The unifying question: what keystone defensive capability, if it existed, would make the world meaningfully harder to break?
You will have extreme latitude to decide what your portfolio should include, and the resources to go build it.
You’ll form strong theses, find extraordinary founders, pressure-test ideas, raise money, build boards, launch organizations, and help them move with the speed and focus of the best deep-tech startups.
Specifically, you will:

• Roadmap the AI resilience landscape to identify the bottlenecks and keystone capabilities worth building organizations around

• Source and diligence ideas for new projects and organizations and design funding calls in partnership with funders

• Build founding teams and help recruit the early hires who will make or break them

• Directly contribute to and coach founders on technical and organizational roadmaps, fundraising, and standing up startup ops from zero

• Serve as a Director on multiple FRO boards, keeping teams on track against milestones and helping founders make the genuinely hard calls on funding, strategic direction, hiring, firing, and operations

• Represent Convergent externally, building high-trust relationships with the philanthropic and public funders now committing serious capital to AI resilience

• Contribute to Convergent-wide initiatives like our Founder Retreats and Residencies

• You understand the AI landscape of 2026 in granular detail: who is building what, why, and on what timeline

• You have ideas, or a credible plan to find ideas, for large-scale efforts that would measurably improve how the world weathers this transition

Veeam's business runs on data flowing from four source systems, v-Power for Sales, Marketo for Marketing, NetSuite for Finance, and Workday for HR, through a governed Databricks Lakehouse to certified outputs consumed by Tableau dashboards and AI agents. The Senior Director, AI-Ready Data Governance has authored the strategy for how this gets governed: a federated, pragmatic model, central standards, distributed ownership, sequenced by outcome so scope is committed on evidence rather than ambition. Continuous, agent-driven scoring keeps watching a certified object's quality on an ongoing basis, well past the moment of sign-off.
This is a builder and execution role for a deep subject matter expert, with full autonomy to move fast and deliver results. You will lead highly complex, high-visibility initiatives, shape the approach to problems that arrive ambiguous, and influence organizational direction through the standards you set. The strategy, mission, and vision are set. AI tooling is moving fast enough that the sequence of what gets built when will keep shifting. title: Assistant Facility Security Officer

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Industrial Security team plays a crucial role in safeguarding classified information and ensuring Anduril’s compliance with DoD security regulations. Customer service is key; we work cross-functionally with Anduril teams and cleared personnel as well as with government counterparts to create a continuously evolving security program that becomes part of the imbedded culture at Anduril.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for an Assistant Facility Security Officer in Quincy, MA to join our rapidly growing team. The Assistant Facility Security Officer (FSO) is responsible for assisting the Facility Security Officer (FSO) with implementing and directing the industrial security program and ensuring company and customer security requirements are met at Anduril’s Boston-area locations (Quincy, MA; Lexington, MA; Woburn, MA; Waltham, MA; Quonset, RI, additional sites as AOR expands). Candidates will interface with all levels of personnel and government management personnel to ensure contract security compliance with 32 CFR, the National Industrial Security Program, the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), Contract Security Classification Specification (DD Form 254) and Security Classification Guides (SCGs). The position requires a self-motivated candidate that can work in an independent or team environment with some direction. The candidate will be required to assist the FSO in developing and implementing processes and procedures, conduct security self-inspections, apply risk mitigation methodologies, support customer assessments, and implement security measures to meet requirements.

title: Principal Product Manager, Payments
description:
Collectors is the leading creator of innovative technology that provides value-added services for collectors worldwide. We grade, authenticate, vault, and sell millions of record-setting collectibles, all while modernizing and digitalizing the process to further our mission of helping collectors pursue their passions. We’re always on the lookout for talented people to join our growing team.

Our services span collectible trading cards, autographs, comic books, coins, video games, event tickets, and memorabilia. Our subsidiaries include PSA, PCGS, Beckett, SGC, and Card Ladder.

Since our founding in 1986, we have graded and authenticated millions of items. We employ more than 3000 people across our headquarters in Santa Ana, California and offices in New Jersey, Texas, Florida, Japan, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Canada, Mexico, Germany, the UK, and France.

As part of our interview process, we request that candidates have their cameras on during video interviews. This helps foster meaningful conversation and allows us to create an experience that closely resembles our standard working environment. Certain interview steps may take place by phone. For remote roles, and at our discretion, candidates may be asked to participate in an on-site interview as part of the final stages of the process.

We understand there may be occasional circumstances requiring accommodation and are happy to discuss them as needed. Your recruiter will be able to clarify expectations and answer any questions you have.

Role Overview
We're looking for an experienced Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution of the payments platform and experiences that help drive the accelerated growth we’ve experienced across our Grading and Marketplace business lines, including our Liquidity offerings and Digital Repacking product ( Power Packs ).
Money movement sits underneath nearly everything Collectors does. Every grading submission, vault transaction, marketplace sale, consignment payout, among other transactional experiences relies on a payment stack that has to be fast, resilient, cost-effective and compliant across a growing number of business models and expanding globally. This role will own that stack outright: how funds come in, how funds go out, how they are routed and how customers see and control their money in our products.
You will work with stakeholders across our Marketplace and Grading business lines, Finance and Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk, as well as other Product and Tech partner teams, with regular exposure to the executive team.
What You'll Do

• Own the payments strategy and roadmap. Set a multi-year direction for the payment platform that serves today's revenue lines and anticipates the ones we haven't launched yet. Sequence platform investment against near-term business commitments and defend those tradeoffs with executives.

• Build a wallet that customers can use across our products and platforms. Own balance and activity views, top-up, withdrawal, and split-pay, turning stored value from a settlement mechanism into a reason customers choose us.

• Take payments international. Deliver the payment, currency, and local method capabilities, partnering with Tax and Legal on registration, reporting obligations including DAC7, and market-by-market compliance.

• Run money-in and money-out end to end. Acquiring, alternative payment methods, payouts, settlement, funding patterns, and reconciliation, including the ledger and reporting foundation Finance depends on for accurate, timely close.
